content_sections.heading: Gautam Buddha Nagar UP Anganwadi Bharti 2026- Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only women candidates are eligible to apply for these posts. For rural area vacancies, the applicant must be a resident of the concerned Gram Sabha; for urban area vacancies, the applicant must reside in the same ward. If no eligible candidate is available in a Gram Sabha, selection will be made from the concerned Nyaya Panchayat as per seniority. A widow candidate must submit a death certificate and an attested copy of the family register issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the concerned Nagar Nikay (Municipal Body). A divorced or deserted woman must submit a valid legal order issued by a court. Selection under the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category will be given priority as per seniority within the prescribed age limit. If no BPL candidate is available, candidates above the BPL income limit will be considered as per seniority. Two women from the same family cannot be appointed as Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika at the same centre. The minimum educational qualification for both Anganwadi Karyakatri and Sahayika posts is Intermediate (12th) , and candidates up to postgraduate level can also apply. Merit will be determined based on the educational qualification held by the candidate, ranging from Intermediate to postgraduate level.

content_sections.heading: Gautam Buddha Nagar UP Anganwadi Karyakatri and Sahayika Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for vacant Anganwadi Karyakatri and Sahayika posts will be conducted entirely online through the portal, as per the guidelines specified in the government order. No written examination or interview will be conducted for these posts. Selection will be based on merit, calculated from the candidate's educational qualification (Intermediate to postgraduate), subject to residency, age, and category eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Karyakatri and Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only women candidates who meet the educational qualification, age, and residency (Gram Sabha/ward) requirements specified in the official notification can apply.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 267 total vacancies - 84 for Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker) and 183 for Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper) - spread across the Shahar, Bisrakh, Dankaur, Dadri, and Jewar project areas.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 28 September 2026, up to midnight.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01 July 2026, and only the High School certificate is valid for age verification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th pass); candidates with qualifications up to postgraduate level can also apply, as merit is calculated on this basis.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written exam or interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No. The selection process is entirely online and merit-based. No written examination or interview will be conducted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or honorarium for Anganwadi Karyakatri and Sahayika posts?
faq.answer: These posts are filled on an honorarium/contract basis, but the exact honorarium amount is not mentioned in the official notification.
